name: house-rules
description: Enforces git identity, attribution and branch-naming rules on Bash calls

gitEmail.title: Git email
gitEmail.description: The only email commits may be authored as. Empty uses your global git user.email.

gitNames.title: Git names
gitNames.description: Comma-separated author names that are accepted. Empty uses your global git user.name.

githubLogin.title: GitHub login
githubLogin.description: gh must be signed in as this account before a PR is opened. Empty skips the check.

blockedBranchPrefixes.title: Blocked branch prefixes
blockedBranchPrefixes.description: Comma-separated branch prefixes that get renamed or blocked.

branchType.title: Replacement branch type
branchType.description: Prefix used when renaming a blocked branch.
